name: Your AI builder's own backend
summary: Use the database and sign-in built into the tool you're already in: Lovable Cloud, Bolt's database, Replit's database and auth, or v0 with a Vercel-connected database.
bestFor: People building in Lovable, Bolt, Replit or v0 who don't want another account.
cost: Included in the builder's plan, usually with a small monthly allowance.
